name: SCAMPS, Sophie

headline.note: Official and professional sources establish hospital and emergency medicine, general practice and a South Western Sydney health-promotion role, but exact appointments, employers, hours, leave and overlaps remain incomplete. Study, athletics without an established employment relationship, nonprofit work, candidacy and elected office are excluded. No public or private full-time years are inferred from year-only ranges or medical titles. Follow-up confirms additional hospital locations and records medical qualifications and political movement work, while correcting activity dates and conflicting qualification descriptions.

career_spells.employer: Athletics teams and any employing or sponsoring entity unresolved
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen Parliamentary Handbook calls Scamps a professional middle-distance athlete. Her member biography and AMA profile record Australian representation, a World Junior gold medal and Olympic qualification, while World Athletics records results from 1986 through 2001. The sources do not establish continuous paid employment, an employing entity, salary, hours or sponsorship terms across that interval. The previous 1986–2001 endpoints represented observed sporting performances, not employment boundaries, so employment dates are now unknown. No identified sponsor is assumed to have been an employer.
career_spells.counting_note: Sporting participation is visible but excluded because substantive paid employment and employer control are not established.

career_spells.evidence_note: Scamps and Parliament identify medical study at the University of Sydney, and the AMA records graduation in 1995. The commencement date, study load and overlap with athletics are not published in the cited sources.
career_spells.counting_note: Study is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.employer: Mona Vale Hospital; Royal North Shore Hospital; unidentified Canberra hospital service
career_spells.evidence_note: Frozen and current parliamentary records give the collective hospital/emergency medicine interval 1995–2000. The archived practice biography directly confirms emergency work in Canberra, Royal North Shore and Mona Vale, resolving the previous primary-source gap. It supplies no facility-specific dates, payroll entities, transfer sequence, hours, leave or breaks; Canberra is a location, not a verified hospital name. Do not assign the entire collective range to each hospital.
career_spells.counting_note: Public hospital work is supported, but year-only boundaries, unresolved appointments and missing full-time evidence prevent an exact duration calculation.

career_spells.employer: Royal College of Surgeons in Ireland, University of Oxford and University of New South Wales
career_spells.role: Postgraduate study: public health, Oxford science qualification and Dublin tropical medicine diploma
career_spells.evidence_note: Current Parliament lists MPH (UNSW), MHScT(Hons) (Oxford) and DipTropMed(Hons) (College of Surgeons, Dublin). The practice biography describes the Oxford award as MSc; the earlier ABC summary described Dublin as a masters. Preserve the discrepancy and prefer the official diploma label rather than representing an Irish masters as settled. Award dates, study loads and work overlaps are unresolved. In April2022 she described the UNSW MPH as part-time distance study in the early2000s, partly overseas. Exact boundaries remain unknown; the interview again calls the Dublin award a masters, conflicting with the official diploma label.
career_spells.counting_note: Study is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen occupation record gives general practice from 2010 to 2021. Member, AMA and ABC profiles identify Narrabeen practice, and the ABC says she practised there until November 2021. The practice's archived profile identifies her as a practitioner. Exact start and cessation days, employment or contractor status, hours, leave and overlap with health-promotion work are not published. Alumni publication independently corroborates November 2021 cessation. Continued inclusion on the March 2022 archived website is not proof of continued practice. Current practice biographies label other doctors independent contractors, but that cannot establish Scamps’s own historical contract. April2022 interview recalls eight years in Narrabeen general practice, shorter than the official2010–2021 interval; location-specific service, breaks and rounding require resolution. A2022 AFR profile reports part-time work without dates or employer allocation; this warns against assuming continuous full-time practice but cannot classify the entire spell.
career_spells.counting_note: Private general practice is supported, but employment status, hours, exact boundaries and overlap are insufficient for a full-time duration calculation.

career_spells.employer: South Western Sydney Local Health District
career_spells.role: Health promotion / community-development project promoting preschool physical activity
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen Parliamentary Handbook records health promotion in the 'Southwest Sydney Local Health District' from 2011. NSW Health identifies the official entity as South Western Sydney Local Health District and records that it was established on 1 January 2011. No located source gives Scamps's title, appointment type, payroll entity, end date, hours, leave or relationship to her overlapping Narrabeen general practice. Her2022 interview describes one year with South West Sydney community health on preschool physical activity. It does not date that year, confirm it was the same2011 role, or establish remuneration; no end year is inferred.
career_spells.counting_note: The government-controlled health district and start year are supported, but the nature, duration and workload of the role are unresolved, so no public full-time duration is counted.

career_spells.evidence_note: Scamps says she founded the community-led nonprofit in 2019, and the AMA described it as an NGO in March 2022. Incorporation, appointment and cessation dates, remuneration, hours and continued involvement after election are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Nonprofit founding and governance are excluded absent evidence of substantive paid employment.

career_spells.evidence_note: The AMA records that Scamps announced her independent candidacy in December 2021, and election sources establish her election on 21 May 2022. The precise announcement day, campaign remuneration, workload and any overlap with medical or nonprofit work are unresolved. Contemporary reporting dates the public launch to 5 December 2021; retain month precision for candidacy because preparations or announcement may precede the launch.
career_spells.counting_note: Independent candidacy and campaigning are excluded from employment totals.

career_spells.role: Member of the House of Representatives for Mackellar
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen roster, current Parliament listing and ABC election record establish House service from the 21 May 2022 election.
career_spells.counting_note: Federal elected office is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.employer: Family Planning Australia and University of Queensland
career_spells.role: Sexual and reproductive health; skin cancer medicine qualifications
career_spells.evidence_note: Healthengine practitioner profile names certificates and awarding providers. The practice archive calls them diplomas in sexual reproductive health and skin cancer management without providers. Award levels therefore differ between profiles; dates and study loads are unknown.
career_spells.counting_note: Excluded category; not added to public/private employment headlines.

career_spells.evidence_note: Better Futures speaker biography identifies co-founding a community movement supporting an independent candidate. This is political organisation activity; the code does not assert it was a registered party. Founding and cessation dates, pay and workload are not supplied. Her first-person 2022 candidate response establishes founding in 2021 with Anyo Geddes; exact month and day remain unknown.
career_spells.counting_note: Excluded category; not added to public/private employment headlines.

career_spells.evidence_note: In her published 2022 candidate response Scamps identifies founding membership in 2020. The organisation describes itself as non-partisan. Exact exit, remuneration and workload are not verified; community consultation is not assumed to be salaried political organising.
career_spells.counting_note: Excluded category; not added to public/private employment headlines.

research_notes: Obtain appointment and payroll records for hospital and emergency-medicine work from 1995 to 2000, confirming or rejecting historical-profile leads for Canberra and Royal North Shore and separating those from the supported Mona Vale placement with exact dates, hours, leave and breaks.

Obtain Narrabeen Family Medical Practice records for the exact 2010–November 2021 interval, employment or contractor status, substantive hours, leave and cessation; resolve the 2000–2010 employment gap and postgraduate-study overlaps.

Clarify the South Western Sydney Local Health District health-promotion role recorded from 2011: title, business unit, appointment type, payroll entity, end date, hours, leave and overlap with Narrabeen general practice.

Determine whether athletics or sponsorship constituted paid substantive employment, and obtain Our Blue Dot incorporation, governance, remuneration and workload records. Resolve campaign remuneration and overlap from December 2021 to election.

2026-10-01 follow-up: recovered primary archived practice biography confirming Canberra, Royal North Shore and Mona Vale emergency work; no facility dates or ordinary hours. Added named medical qualification providers and Mackellar Rising co-founding. Corrected athletics dates that previously represented performance observations and the unverified Dublin masters description.

Searched health-promotion role, public professional profiles, hospital names, Oxford dates and part-time references. No Scamps-specific SWSLHD contract, roster, payroll or cessation was found; unrelated doctors’ hours and current independent-contractor arrangements were not transferred. 2000–2010 work/study chronology, individual hospital boundaries and leave remain open.

Next leads: historical practice personnel biographies, public hospital appointment/department records and contemporaneous university award records. Oxford club athletics indexes a 2004 performance, which is not proof of degree boundaries or professional work; direct club page returned Internal Error. First-person candidate response now confirms Voices of Mackellar founding in 2020 and Mackellar Rising in 2021; January 2021 Voices exit remains unverified. Women in Public Health lists her as a founding member alongside her MP role, without separate employment evidence.

Second follow-up2October2026 materially adds self-reported part-time MPH study and a one-year preschool-activity community-health project; flags the conflicting eight-year Narrabeen recollection and a secondary part-time employment report. No precise hospital appointment, health-promotion endpoint, payroll contract or leave schedule found. Public LinkedIn page returned999 Unknown Status Code; no authenticated or alternate-route access attempted. AFR direct open returned Internal Error; limited indexed statement retained with its limitations. Study load must not be transferred to employment; the undated project must not manufacture a2012 cessation. Further leads: project reports, employer rosters and qualification conferral records.

Third follow-up3October2026: targeted exact-name searches for the preschool physical-activity project, South Western Sydney health-promotion appointment and Canberra/Royal North Shore/Mona Vale hospital chronology returned only the already recorded first-person interview, parliamentary chronology and practice biography. The publicly indexed LinkedIn profile exposes no prior role titles or dates and was not used to fill gaps. No project report, employer roster, payroll entity, hours, leave or precise boundary was found; existing facts and null totals remain unchanged.
